mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates on future corporate cash flows and increasing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or the average return is not statistically positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 9.5% over a single month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer confidence and corporate hiring expectations, which leads to lower earnings growth forecasts and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 9.5%, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction permits (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and triggers a sell-off in equities, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.5 for two consecutive months signals a contraction in real economic output, increasing recession risk and prompting equity investors to reduce exposure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% and inflation (CPIAUCSL) remains above 2.5%, it indicates a restrictive monetary policy environment that raises discount rates and suppresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when both FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or the signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in residential construction permits (HOUST) above 580,000 units in two consecutive months, combined with rising real personal consumption (RSAFS), signals a recovery in private demand, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of triggered instances, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) below 50,000 jobs per month, combined with a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE), indicates labor market weakening, reducing consumer spending power and corporate hiring, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both PAYEMS < 50 and UNRATE rises > 0.2pp, or the signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) above 360,000 million dollars, coupled with rising industrial production (INDPRO), indicates strong aggregate demand and economic momentum, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
